summary: Haoxin Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K regarding a Note Purchase Agreement and issuance of convertible promissory notes totaling $1,200,000 original principal amount, with a purchase price of $1,000,000. The notes are convertible into Class A ordinary shares at a discount to the lowest traded price. The filing describes standard terms, covenants, and events of default for a convertible note financing. No special situation event triggering category classification is present; it is a routine capital-raising transaction via convertible debt.
